title: Changed AutoColumnSize so that on a grid with more than 1,000,000 cells in its default `syncLimit` columns, no `syncLimit` set, and AutoRowSize off, the constructor and `loadData()` measure only the columns needed to draw the grid (the columns on screen and the columns their merged cells span) and measure the rest in the background: `getColWidth()` returns the default width for a column not measured yet, while `selectCell()` and `scrollViewportTo()` measure the columns up to their target first.
